subject: The Designed Manufactured Installed promise
hook: Will the people who fit it know how it was designed?
fb:
Will the people who fit it know how it was designed? A really good question to ask any furniture company.

With us, yes. Design, manufacture and installation all happen in-house, so the survey notes, drawings and finish choices from your consultation go to our Hanley workshop and then on to our own installation team. If anything on the day needs a decision, like a pipe that wasn't expected or a wall that's further out than it looked, it's handled by people who understand the whole job.

Got a question before you book? Ask us here:
https://superiofurniture.com/furniture-installation/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=whole-home-bespoke-solutions&utm_content=day-336
